tasks.instruction: Run the image node once through the real RunningHub provider (Seedream text-to-image): submit the task, query it until it reaches the provider's terminal SUCCESS state, and leave exactly one persisted image artifact whose provenance names this node. The run is paid and pre-approved through the task's declared approval; do not resubmit, do not print the API key, and do not write to any project other than the bound one.

missingPredicates.name: provider.task_terminal_status_equals
missingPredicates.reason: RunningHub's wire status is 'SUCCESS'; the harness's runtime task vocabulary is 'completed'/'succeeded'. task.status_equals: 'completed' is encoded assuming the serial driver normalizes the provider-terminal state into the runtime task record. If the driver surfaces the raw 'SUCCESS', this predicate cannot express it.

approvals: approve one real paid RunningHub Seedream text-to-image generation

tasks.runnerScopeReason: Real-provider certification: only a serial, parent-driven run against the live RunningHub API counts as evidence. The deterministic runners replay into the controlled world's fake provider, and the codex runner's write-replay seam (codexWriteToGatewayCall) cannot express workflow.node.run, so provider-evidence predicates are only observable through a driver that captures the real runtime/provider ledger into the normalized snapshot shape.

realCapture.description: Produced by the serial parent driver after a real RunningHub workflow.node.run; absent => blocked, never a capability failure.
